title: False-Negative Risk Audit and Training Exclusion Manifest
audit_objective: Determine false-negative supervision risks of images containing rejected garment annotations in YOLO training

rejected_items.violation_details: Coordinates exceed boundaries: y2=626 not in [0, 624]
Coordinates exceed boundaries: y2=829 not in [0, 702]
Bounding box [x1=0, y1=0, x2=0, y2=0] has dx=0, dy=0, area=0

028225.garment_inventory: 2 visible annotated garments: item1 (short sleeve top) and item2 (trousers)
028225.yolo_status: 1 valid label row in 028225.txt (item1 top only). Missing: item2 trousers
028225.physical_presence: Confirmed. Visible dark trousers on lower body. Segmentation mask spans X=[3, 412], Y=[202, 625]
028225.false_negative_risk_mechanism: Partial-annotation false-negative supervision: In YOLO loss, any prediction with IoU > background threshold on the unannotated trousers will be treated as an unassigned anchor / false positive. The objectness branch will penalize confidence toward 0 and classification loss will suppress class 7 (trousers), teaching the network to ignore real trousers in similar compositions.
028225.repair_protocol: Manually verified bounding box recovery: Clip bottom coordinate from y2=626 to image boundary y2=624 ([1, 198, 422, 624]), or re-derive tighter bounding box from segmentation bounds ([3, 202, 412, 624]). Do not include in training partition until repaired.

115063.garment_inventory: 1 visible annotated garment: item1 (short sleeve top)
115063.yolo_status: 0 valid label rows in 115063.txt (empty file). Missing: item1 top
115063.physical_presence: Confirmed. Salient patterned short-sleeve top covering central frame. Segmentation spans X=[26, 377], Y=[226, 641]
115063.false_negative_risk_mechanism: Pure-negative false-negative supervision (CRITICAL): An empty label file causes YOLO to treat the ENTIRE image as background. Every single anchor across all pyramid levels matching the prominent, centered short-sleeve top is penalized with target objectness = 0. This directly poisons the model's confidence calibration for the most common garment class (short sleeve top, 22.95% of dataset), actively teaching the network NOT to detect tops.
115063.severity: CRITICAL (Toxic false-negative supervision on prominent centered subject)
115063.repair_protocol: Manually verified bounding box recovery: Recompute bounding box from verified segmentation mask ([26, 226, 377, 641]) or re-annotate torso box manually. Under NO circumstances should this image be retained in training as an empty/background sample.

101338.garment_inventory: 2 visible annotated garments: item1 (skirt) and item2 (short sleeve top)
101338.yolo_status: 1 valid label row in 101338.txt (item1 skirt only). Missing: item2 top
101338.physical_presence: Confirmed. Model clearly wears a white/light short-sleeve top above the skirt. Segmentation spans X=[338, 446], Y=[332, 448]
101338.false_negative_risk_mechanism: Partial-annotation false-negative supervision: The upper torso containing the visible short-sleeve top has no label. Any candidate box predicted by the model on this shirt is penalized as a false positive, degrading model recall specifically on tops paired with skirts.
101338.repair_protocol: Manually verified bounding box recovery: Derive bounding box from verified segmentation bounds ([338, 332, 446, 448]) with human verification, or re-annotate top manually. Exclude from training until repaired.

yolo_training_supervision_impact.objectness_loss_penalty: In YOLO loss formulations (BCE/Focal loss on objectness), unannotated foreground objects receive target = 0. Correct detections generate high loss and negative gradients, actively suppressing detector recall.
yolo_training_supervision_impact.classification_loss_penalty: Unannotated foreground objects prevent true class gradient updates and induce class ambiguity.
yolo_training_supervision_impact.background_sample_misrepresentation: Image 115063.jpg currently has an empty YOLO label file. In object detection, empty files are treated as true negatives (background scenes without garments). However, 115063 contains a prominent short-sleeve top. Retaining it as background constitutes severe label noise.
